Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1792 (Somatostatin receptor type 5). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1792, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
